video_title: Rockets Postgame: Ime Udoka on Kevin Durant and Sengun's Performance

quotes.speaker: Ime Udoka
quotes.summary_phrase: Ime Udoka on the Rockets' offensive rebounding strategy
quotes.excerpt: It's what we do. We touch the paint and shoot the ball with confidence.
quotes.quote: It's what we do. We touch the paint and shoot the ball with confidence. If you make them, great. If you miss them, you got a chance to get them back and get those second-chance points which we didn't do at a high level. But all being said, good job attacking there. Stevens obviously doing what he does and others contributed as well.
quotes.social_post: Ime Udoka on the Rockets offensive rebounding strategy: It is what we do. We touch the paint and shoot the ball with confidence. If you miss them, you got a chance to get them back and get those second chance points.

structured.context: Ime Udoka discusses the team's offensive rebounding strategy and performance during the postgame press conference.

quotes.speaker: Ime Udoka
quotes.summary_phrase: Ime Udoka on Fred VanVleet's performance down the stretch
quotes.excerpt: He got us settled. Didn't love the way we lacked organization at the start of the fourth.
quotes.quote: He got us settled. Didn't love the way we lacked organization at the start of the fourth and I saw that in the whole group in general. We got to have our bigs rolling in the pocket to collapse the defense, got to have guys being aggressive. It's not just about making shots, it's about getting organized and getting the right look and we didn't have that for a stretch there. Good to get him back in a little earlier than usual, got two days off and extended his time a little bit, but that's what he's here for.
quotes.social_post: Ime Udoka on Fred VanVleet: He got us settled. It is not just about making shots, it is about getting organized and getting the right look and we did not have that for a stretch there.

structured.context: Ime Udoka explains how Fred VanVleet helped the team get organized during the fourth quarter.

quotes.speaker: Ime Udoka
quotes.summary_phrase: Ime Udoka on the defensive game plan against Booker and Green
quotes.excerpt: Don't always look at the end number, you look at the effectiveness.
quotes.quote: Anytime Booker got 25, but 11 on raw free throws, you're shooting 6 for 18 and Jalen 8 for 21, so don't always look at the end number, you look at the effectiveness to your point and holding them to low field goals. Like the attention to detail on those guys for the most part. They got some things, Jalen getting downhill, reaching the screens and Booker off the kick-outs getting some of those threes as well, but overall made them work through a lot of bodies at them.
quotes.social_post: Ime Udoka on the defensive game plan: Do not always look at the end number, you look at the effectiveness to your point and holding them to low field goals. Like the attention to detail on those guys for the most part.

structured.context: Ime Udoka evaluates the defensive game plan used against Devin Booker and Jalen Green.

quotes.speaker: Ime Udoka
quotes.summary_phrase: Ime Udoka on the team's struggles with free throws
quotes.excerpt: It kind of snowballed tonight, we were 16 for 30, so missed quite a few.
quotes.quote: It kind of snowballed tonight, we were 16 for 30, so missed quite a few. We had missed 10 in the first half at least and so got a little bit better but we only shot four in the second half, so we were two for four there. To go 14 for 26 in the first half and have a 10-point lead with the way we shot the three is a good sign that our defense was guarding well, but like to knock those ones down, extend the lead there and just didn't get the reps in the second half, only four.
quotes.social_post: Ime Udoka on the Rockets free throw struggles: It kind of snowballed tonight, we were 16 for 30, so missed quite a few. We had missed 10 in the first half at least.

structured.context: Ime Udoka comments on the team's struggles with free throw shooting throughout the game.

quotes.speaker: Ime Udoka
quotes.summary_phrase: Ime Udoka on Kevin Durant's scoring milestones
quotes.excerpt: It's almost a second nature thing now. Guys don't really celebrate it too much.
quotes.quote: It's almost a second nature thing now. Guys don't really celebrate it too much because they just joked in there he's passing so many that he's getting a ball every few games or whatever. While you're in it playing with someone, that's great, that is that great, and as he's passing all these milestones you're kind of just taking it for granted at times. But you look back on it and the accomplishments are things that can't be duplicated. Guys recognize it, I'm sure he will at the end of his career, but he's surpassing so many things it's almost becoming second nature now.
quotes.social_post: Ime Udoka on Kevin Durant hitting milestones: It is almost becoming second nature now. Guys do not really celebrate it too much because they just joked in there he is passing so many that he is getting a ball every few games.

structured.context: Ime Udoka reflects on Kevin Durant reaching various scoring milestones in his career.

quotes.speaker: Ime Udoka
quotes.summary_phrase: Ime Udoka on Alperen Sengun's development and triple-doubles
quotes.excerpt: It's been great. He's flirting with them every night now, so it's almost becoming commonplace.
quotes.quote: It's been great. We recognized him as well tonight for that, for another one and he's flirting with them every night now, so it's almost becoming commonplace. It's very impressive the way he's grown and he dominates the game in all these different ways and luxury for us to have a big that can do all those things, not just a low-post scorer, but the isolations, the assist numbers are high, and guys especially when they're making shots and he's still on the glass doing his thing there. He's grown a ton, he's taking a huge step this year as well and we love the progress he's making.
quotes.social_post: Ime Udoka on Alperen Sengun: He is flirting with triple doubles every night now, so it is almost becoming commonplace. It is very impressive the way he has grown and he dominates the game in all these different ways.

structured.context: Ime Udoka praises the growth and development of Alperen Sengun after another triple-double performance.

quotes.speaker: Ime Udoka
quotes.summary_phrase: Ime Udoka on the team's defensive composure against Dylan Brooks
quotes.excerpt: You have to keep composure, not get caught up in it.
quotes.quote: You have to keep composure, not get caught up in it. The team that's either crying or whining about certain things, you kind of get the edge on and Dylan that's a big part of what he does. It's going to be there every night with him, we know that and for good or bad it can help your team or kind of hinder your team at times and I think our guys did a good job of keeping their cool and playing through it, although quite a few guys got technicals.
quotes.social_post: Ime Udoka on Dillon Brooks: The team that is either crying or whining about certain things, you kind of get the edge on and Dillon that is a big part of what he does. It can help your team or kind of hinder your team at times.

structured.context: Ime Udoka discusses the importance of maintaining composure while playing against Dillon Brooks.
